citations.assessment: Ketubot gives the same three alternatives in reverse order with Rav titles. The Chanana headword expressly points back to this entry.
The Shmuel headword gives the reciprocal patronymic, and the exact Yerushalmi Berakhot gives the same chain from Rabbi Chanina.
